issues.claim: Kinkisharyo International LLC, 145 Baekeland Ave — listed as an active manufacturer
issues.problem: The 145–149 Baekeland Ave site was sold in 2026 to Deugen Investment Group by a Kinkisharyo affiliate, so the company is no longer the occupant of this address. The only evidence was a Cylex directory line.
issues.fix: Remove the entry, or re-verify with the company/Deugen before any outreach.

issues.claim: Children's Wear Ctr, 1339 Centennial Ave (one directory only, no phone)
issues.problem: Directory records put the children's-wear shop at that address, but other listings identify 1339 Centennial Ave as Asian Food Market, so the shop appears to be gone; nothing confirms it exists today.
issues.fix: Drop the entry unless a current second source (storefront, licence, phone pickup) confirms it.

issues.claim: Sonovi, 409 Bell St — categorised as 'Event venue'
issues.problem: Its own site describes Sonovi as a personal-training gym that rents its space for small events (max ~50). Its own website (sonovi.com) and phone (201) 777-0039 were both missed and the listing rests on an Eventective page only.
issues.fix: Recategorise as fitness/event rental, add the company site and phone, or move it to the group B/A file.

issues.problem: 31 Gordon Rd is only supported by older directories; a newer listing places Bizerba USA at 239 Old New Brunswick Rd, Piscataway. Site also has no phone recorded.
issues.fix: Confirm the current address (or drop) before outreach.

issues.claim: Sabinsa Corp, 70 Ethel Rd W, #6 — described as the group's US headquarters
issues.problem: The only address evidence found is a 2005 patent filing; Sabinsa's published US headquarters is in East Windsor. Could not confirm a current Piscataway presence.
issues.fix: Verify with the company (state registry or site) or remove from the working list.

issues.claim: Excluded-type scan: EMSL Analytical (1056 Stelton Rd) and Eurofins CRL (371 Hoes Ln)
issues.problem: Both are branches of national/global laboratory chains (EMSL runs ~40 US labs; Eurofins CRL is a Eurofins company). Under the brief's 'chains and franchises' exclusion they are not independent local businesses, and the list excluded franchises elsewhere.
issues.fix: Move both to the chain bucket. If the owner wants corporate branches kept, apply one consistent rule (EMSL/Eurofins vs the already-removed franchises).

issues.claim: Excluded-type scan: Cascades Piscataway, 1 Turner Pl
issues.problem: The company's own facility page calls it 'a division of Cascades Holding US Inc', a multi-billion-dollar packaging group with hundreds of plants. That is a corporate plant, not an independent business, and it very likely fails the mapper's own size/independence test.
issues.fix: Triage for headcount; default to the excluded/chain bucket unless the site is independently run.

issues.claim: National Educational Music Company, 1110 Centennial Ave, phone (908) 232-6700
issues.problem: The Piscataway location page gives 800-526-4593 and the page title references the Mountainside NJ operation; (908) 232-6700 looks like the old Mountainside HQ number rather than the Piscataway site.
issues.fix: Update to the location phone or mark the number as unverified.

issues.claim: Electronics Design Group, 60 Ethel Rd, #4, phone Unknown
issues.problem: BBB and other listings give 60 Ethel Road West, Suite 5 and (732) 650-9800. The suite is wrong and the phone was left as Unknown although it is published.
issues.fix: Correct to 60 Ethel Rd W, Suite 5 and add (732) 650-9800.

issues.claim: Zwiegart-Joan Toggitt Ltd, 262 Old New Brunswick Rd, #E
issues.problem: The company name is misspelled (Zweigart-Joan Toggitt Ltd) and a directory phone (732) 562-8888 was not captured.

issues.claim: Entries with a company website but recorded as website-less: Sharron Art Center (sharronartcenter.com), T&P Machine Company (tpmachinecompany.com)
issues.problem: Both firms publish their own sites, which the list leaves blank ('Unknown'/'one directory only'), understating how contactable they are.
issues.fix: Populate the website field from the companies' own sites.

issues.claim: Coverage gaps: Victor Machine Inc (31 Suttons Ln), Tetiana Chernenko Photography (Piscataway)
issues.problem: Both are in-zone, independent, eligible businesses that surfaced in category searches but are absent from the list. Paws & Bubbles (mobile grooming, (908) 565-0835) was dropped for lack of a street address even though it appears in pet-grooming listings.
issues.fix: Add the two with sources; keep Paws & Bubbles in a no-address holding file.

issues.problem: Multi-branch regional chains (Central Turf & Irrigation Supply, General Plumbing Supply, Colonial Electric Supply) were kept with caveats, while AB&S Piscataway (60B W Ethel Rd, abswhse.com) — the same kind of regional branch chain — is not listed at all.
issues.fix: Apply one rule: either add AB&S with the same caveat or move all four to the chain bucket.
